title: Bunkie
subtitle: Brand Identity & Design System
overview: The objective was to create a cohesive, scalable brand identity and design system from the ground up. The goal was to translate brand values into a unified visual language, ensuring consistency across digital and print touchpoints through an accessible set of brand guidelines.
problem:
Without a unified brand identity, cross-platform assets often suffer from inconsistent typography, mismatched color palettes, and fragmented messaging. The key challenges were:

- Developing a distinct logo and visual mark that communicates the core ethos.
- Establishing an accessible color hierarchy and robust typography system.
- Creating clear guidelines to ensure seamless implementation for design and development teams.
solution: Delivered a complete brand identity system built on a distinct logo suite, an accessible color palette with WCAG AA contrast compliance, a robust typography hierarchy, and structured brand guidelines. A shared component library and single source of truth for brand assets ensure consistent implementation across digital and print touchpoints.

features.title: Logo Suite
features.description: Primary logo, secondary mark, app icon, and clear-space specifications for adaptability across light/dark themes and varying screen sizes.

features.title: Color Palette
features.description: Primary brand colors, functional UI colors, and background tones supporting visual hierarchy and WCAG AA contrast compliance.

features.title: Typography System
features.description: Display/heading scale, body text styles, and button/label styles ensuring consistent vertical rhythm and clear visual hierarchy.

features.title: Brand Rules
features.description: Incorrect usage examples, photographic guidelines, and tone of voice for long-term consistency across internal teams and vendors.

results.description: Streamlined the design-to-development workflow by centralizing all brand assets
Visual alignment across social media assets, digital product UI, and collateral
Built to expand alongside future product lines and marketing campaigns

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.content:
Role: Brand Designer & UI/UX Specialist

Deliverables: Brand Strategy, Visual Identity System, Brand Guidelines Document, Component Library

Tools Used: Figma, Adobe Illustrator

sections.title: Process & Approach
sections.content:
Step 1: Research & Discovery

Brand Audit & Strategy: Analyzed market positioning, target audience demographics, and competitor branding to define visual tone and personality keywords.

Moodboarding: Explored visual directions focusing on modern aesthetics, legibility, and geometric balance.

Step 2: Visual Identity Development

Logo & Mark: Iterated on primary logo formats, iconography, and clear-space rules to maintain visual integrity across different screen sizes and print formats.

Color System: Defined primary, secondary, and neutral palettes with strict accessibility contrast ratios (WCAG compliance) for digital applications.

Typography Hierarchy: Selected versatile typeface pairings for headlines, body copy, and UI components to ensure readability across devices.

Step 3: Guidelines & Systems Design

Built a structured Brand Guidelines document covering logo usage, color codes (HEX, RGB, CMYK), typography scales, icon sets, and explicit imagery do's and don'ts.

sections.title: Impact & Results
sections.content:
- Efficiency: Streamlined the design-to-development workflow by providing a single source of truth for all brand assets.
- Consistency: Ensured 100% visual alignment across social media assets, digital product UI, and collateral.
- Scalability: Built a flexible system capable of expanding alongside future product lines and marketing campaigns.
